source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Consult with bridge inspection and maintenance personnel.
3. Seek information about the construction documents of the defects.
4. Examine photographs of the defects.
5. Obtain details through careful measurement of the defects.
6. Compare the condition of the defects with past condition.
7. Investigate local needs and requirements.
8. Visit the defect site and inspect it thoroughly.
9. Study the structural drawing of the project site.
10. Consult with the designer of the project, if necessary.

Note: It is important to accurately document the structural defects in a bridge maintenance report to ensure proper maintenance and repairs are carried out. These steps will help in identifying the defects accurately and effectively.<eos>
